title: George Pickens is not at OTAs, Cowboys expect him to be at mandatory minicamp

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: George Pickens is not at OTAs, Cowboys expect him to be at mandatory minicamp
sources.description: Cowboys wide receiver George Pickens didn't attend the early phases of the team's offseason workouts and he didn't change course for the team's first week of OTAs.
